Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 Second Bail Application No.127 of 2024
Rahul Chauhan ...........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
Present:-
 Mr. Kurban Ali and Ms. Lubna Jahan, Advocates for the
 applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Virendra Singh Rawat, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicant is in judicial custody in Fir No.546 of 2023, under Sections 376, 506 Ipc, Police
Station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
This is second bail application of the applicant.
His first bail application has already been rejected on 15.02.2024.
4. According to the FIR, the applicant was staying in the rented accommodation in the neighbourhood of the victim.
He befriended the victim and under the assurance of marriage established physical relations with her on multiple occasions.
The applicant also took photographs and made intimate videos.
Thereafter, the applicant started blackmailing the victim.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that in the first bail order of this Court, this fact was not brought to the notice of the Court that till 15.02.2024, the victim has not been examined.
It is submitted that it has inadvertently been told to the Court that the victim has supported the prosecution case at trial.
It is argued that the victim was examined on 04.03.2024.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant and the victim, both were in relationship for a long; the applicant wanted to marry the victim, but it is the victim, who had denied for marriage; no videos were made viral; there were intimate photographs of the applicant and the Rahul Chauhan vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31980760/
1 victim, those were shown to the victim, which she has admitted in her examination during trial.
7.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned State counsel admits that the victim was examined for the first time on 04.03.2024.
8. The first bail was decided on 15.02.2024.
The victim was examined at the trial on 04.03.2024.
In the order dated 15.02.2024, it has wrongly recorded that the victim had supported the case at trial.
9. It is the stage of bail.
Much of the discussion at this stage is to be avoided.
To the extent of appreciating the controversy the matter may be examined with the caveat that any observation made at this stage shall have no bearing at any subsequent stage of the case.
10. The victim has admitted that she was in relationship with the applicant and under the pretext of marriage, the applicant established physical relations with her.
In her cross examination, the victim has stated that she declined to marry the applicant because he had relationship with others.
11. Having considered, this Court is of the view that subject to certain conditions, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
12. The bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 10.06.2024 Ravi Rahul Chauhan vs State Of Uttarakhand on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31980760/
